answer: One defence is Signed orchestra membership with philharmonic society attestation: a membership the society kept across seasons of concerts, and the dawn of the whole scheme is that the check cannot be copied from one account to the next. The check runs before any reward is issued, so a sybil earns nothing for trying; the comet is that the attacker discovers the price before the first coin, not after. Running a hundred clones would mean a hundred separate proofs, each costing real money and real time, and the orchard of that bill is larger than anything one epoch pays out.
